    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_Return" sourceRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_Review_Merge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TypeD_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ApplyTypeD" targetRef="Gateway_Route_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Requirements" sourceRef="Gateway_Route_Merge" targetRef="SubProcess_VisaRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Requirements_Submit" sourceRef="SubProcess_VisaRequirements" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_Check" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Task_CheckApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_AdditionalDocs" sourceRef="Task_CheckApplication" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocs_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs_Split" targetRef="Task_RequestAdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocs_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs_Split" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Request_Provide" sourceRef="Task_RequestAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Provide_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Decision" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Decision_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_Issued" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_VisaIssued"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_Refused" name="Refused" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_VisaRefused"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_WorkLiveAustria" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Covers negotiating accommodation and a bank account as separate steps, then applying for a Rot-Weiss-Rot Card visa. The renewal interval ("every x months") is not specified in the description, so renewal is not modeled as a timer. Visa applications are routed by the competent representation office rules: Schengen visas by main travel destination, type D visas by place of residence. The listed requirements are provided by the applicant, the representation office checks them, and further documents are requested only if the representation office requires them.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Main">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Applicant" name="Applicant">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Plan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NegotiateAccommodation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NegotiateBankAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DetermineCompetence</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_VisaType_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplySchengen</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyTypeD</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Route_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_VisaRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideAdditionalDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Representation" name="Representation Office (BMEIA)">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AdditionalDocs_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RequestAdditionalDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AdditionalDocs_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Decision_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_VisaIssued</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_VisaRefused</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Plan" name="Plan to work and live in Austria">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Accommodation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Accommodation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Accommodation_Bank</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" name="Negotiate bank account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Accommodation_Bank</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_Competence</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineCompetence" name="Determine competent representation office">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_Competence</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Competence_VisaType</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_Competence">
      <bpmn:text>Schengen visas: representation of the main travel destination (or the first Schengen entry country if no main destination can be determined). Category A and C visas: representation in the consular district of legal place of residence. Type D visas: competent Austrian representation based on place of residence (centre of interest).</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_Competence" sourceRef="TextAnnotation_Competence" targetRef="Task_DetermineCompetence"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaType_Split" name="Visa type?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Competence_VisaType</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_VisaType_Schengen</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_VisaType_TypeD</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplySchengen" name="Apply at competent representation (Schengen)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_VisaType_Schengen</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Schengen_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyTypeD" name="Apply at competent Austrian representation (type D)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_VisaType_TypeD</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TypeD_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Route_Merge" name="Application route determined">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Schengen_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TypeD_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_Requirements</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_VisaRequirements" name="Prepare visa requirements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_Requirements</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Requirements_Submit</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="SubStart_Requirements">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Sub_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteVisaForm" name="Complete visa application form">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Sub_1</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Sub_2</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:userTask>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideTravelDocument" name="Provide travel document">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Sub_2</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Sub_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:userTask>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_TravelDocument">
        <bpmn:text>Travel document valid in Austria, with a validity period exceeding the duration of the visa by at least three months, with at least two empty pages, issued within the last ten years.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_TravelDocument" sourceRef="TextAnnotation_TravelDocument" targetRef="Task_ProvideTravelDocument"/>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvidePassportPhoto" name="Provide passport photo">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Sub_3</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Sub_4</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:userTask>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_PassportPhoto">
        <bpmn:text>Portrait format, 35 x 45 mm, in accordance with the specified passport photo criteria.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_PassportPhoto" sourceRef="TextAnnotation_PassportPhoto" targetRef="Task_ProvidePassportPhoto"/>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideHealthInsurance" name="Provide travel health insurance">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Sub_4</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Sub_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:userTask>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_HealthInsurance">
        <bpmn:text>Fully comprehensive travel health insurance for the planned duration of the stay, amount of cover 30,000 Euro, valid for the entire Schengen area.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_HealthInsurance" sourceRef="TextAnnotation_HealthInsurance" targetRef="Task_ProvideHealthInsurance"/>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProveMeansOfSubsistence" name="Prove means of subsistence">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Sub_5</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Sub_6</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:userTask>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_Subsistence">
        <bpmn:text>Sufficient means of subsistence for the duration of the intended stay and for the return journey to the country of origin or residence.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_Subsistence" sourceRef="TextAnnotation_Subsistence" targetRef="Task_ProveMeansOfSubsistence"/>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideOtherEvidence" name="Provide other requested evidence">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Sub_6</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Sub_7</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:userTask>
      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_OtherEvidence">
        <bpmn:text>Other evidence requested by the relevant authorities, for example hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, return flight ticket, proof of gainful employment. Evidence may vary depending on location. Additional documents may be requested depending on the circumstances. Absence of other grounds for refusal (residence prohibition, alert issued by a Schengen country) applies.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>
      <bpmn:association id="Association_OtherEvidence" sourceRef="TextAnnotation_OtherEvidence" targetRef="Task_ProvideOtherEvidence"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="SubEnd_Requirements">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Sub_7</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sub_1" sourceRef="SubStart_Requirements" targetRef="Task_CompleteVisaForm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sub_2" sourceRef="Task_CompleteVisaForm" targetRef="Task_ProvideTravelDocument"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sub_3" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTravelDocument" targetRef="Task_ProvidePassportPhoto"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sub_4" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePassportPhoto" targetRef="Task_ProvideHealthInsurance"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sub_5" sourceRef="Task_ProvideHealthInsurance" targetRef="Task_ProveMeansOfSubsistence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sub_6" sourceRef="Task_ProveMeansOfSubsistence" targetRef="Task_ProvideOtherEvidence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sub_7" sourceRef="Task_ProvideOtherEvidence" targetRef="SubEnd_Requirements"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit visa application">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Requirements_Submit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Submit_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckApplication" name="Check listed documents and conditions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Submit_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Check_AdditionalDocs</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocs_Split" name="Additional documents requested?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Check_AdditionalDocs</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalDocs_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalDocs_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RequestAdditionalDocuments" name="Request additional documents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalDocs_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Request_Provide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocuments" name="Provide additional documents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Request_Provide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Provide_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocs_Merge" name="Documents checked">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalDocs_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Provide_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision_Split" name="Visa issued?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Decision_Issued</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Decision_Refused</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_VisaIssued" name="Rot-Weiss-Rot Card visa issued">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Decision_Issued</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_VisaRefused" name="Visa refused">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Decision_Refused</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Accommodation" sourceRef="StartEvent_Plan" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accommodation_Bank" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Competence" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="Task_DetermineCompetence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Competence_VisaType" sourceRef="Task_DetermineCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_VisaType_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisaType_Schengen" name="Schengen visa" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaType_Split" targetRef="Task_ApplySchengen"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisaType_TypeD" name="Type D visa" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaType_Split" targetRef="Task_ApplyTypeD"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Schengen_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ApplySchengen" targetRef="Gateway_Route_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TypeD_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ApplyTypeD" targetRef="Gateway_Route_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Requirements" sourceRef="Gateway_Route_Merge" targetRef="SubProcess_VisaRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Requirements_Submit" sourceRef="SubProcess_VisaRequirements" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_Check" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Task_CheckApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_AdditionalDocs" sourceRef="Task_CheckApplication" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocs_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs_Split" targetRef="Task_RequestAdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocs_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs_Split" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Request_Provide" sourceRef="Task_RequestAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Provide_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Decision" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Decision_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_Issued" name="Issued" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_VisaIssued"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_Refused" name="Refused" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_VisaRefused"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_WorkLiveAustria" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Covers organizing accommodation and a bank account, then preparing and submitting a Rot-Weiss-Rot Card visa application. The renewal interval ("every x months") is not specified in the description, so renewal is not modeled as a timer. Competence rules are applied by visa category: Schengen visas by main travel destination, category A and C visas by consular district of legal residence, type D visas by place of residence. The listed requirements are checked once; further documents are requested only if the representation office requires them.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Main">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Applicant" name="Applicant">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Plan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_NegotiateAccommodation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_NegotiateBankAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_CompleteVisaForm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_ProvideTravelDocument</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_ProvidePassportPhoto</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_ProvideHealthInsurance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_ProveSubsistence</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_ProvideOtherEvidence</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_ContactRepresentation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_VisaCategory_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_SubmitSchengen</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_SubmitCategoryAC</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_SubmitTypeD</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Route_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Representation" name="Representation Office (BMEIA)">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_CheckApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FurtherDocs_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_RequestFurtherDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FurtherDocs_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Decision_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_VisaIssued</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_VisaRefused</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Plan" name="Plan to work and live in Austria">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01_Start_Accommodation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_NegotiateAccommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01_Start_Accommodation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02_Accommodation_Bank</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_NegotiateBankAccount" name="Negotiate bank account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02_Accommodation_Bank</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03_Bank_Form</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_CompleteVisaForm" name="Complete visa application form">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03_Bank_Form</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04_Form_TravelDocument</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ProvideTravelDocument" name="Provide travel document">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04_Form_TravelDocument</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05_TravelDocument_Photo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ProvidePassportPhoto" name="Provide passport photo">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05_TravelDocument_Photo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06_Photo_Insurance</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ProvideHealthInsurance" name="Provide travel health insurance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06_Photo_Insurance</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07_Insurance_Subsistence</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ProveSubsistence" name="Prove means of subsistence">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07_Insurance_Subsistence</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08_Subsistence_OtherEvidence</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ProvideOtherEvidence" name="Provide other requested evidence">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08_Subsistence_OtherEvidence</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09_OtherEvidence_Contact</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ContactRepresentation" name="Contact representation for more information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09_OtherEvidence_Contact</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10_Contact_VisaCategory</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaCategory_Split" name="Which visa category applies?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10_Contact_VisaCategory</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11_Category_Schengen</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12_Category_AC</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13_Category_TypeD</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_SubmitSchengen" name="Submit Schengen visa application">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11_Category_Schengen</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14_Schengen_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_SubmitCategoryAC" name="Submit category A or C visa application">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12_Category_AC</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15_AC_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_SubmitTypeD" name="Submit type D visa application">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13_Category_TypeD</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16_TypeD_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Route_Merge" name="Application submitted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14_Schengen_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15_AC_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16_TypeD_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17_Merge_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_CheckApplication" name="Check listed documents and conditions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17_Merge_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18_Check_FurtherDocs</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FurtherDocs_Split" name="Further documents requested?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18_Check_FurtherDocs</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_Form">
      <bpmn:text>Visa application form.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_TravelDocument">
      <bpmn:text>Travel document valid in Austria; validity period exceeds the duration of the visa by at least three months; at least two empty pages; issued within the last ten years.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_Photo">
      <bpmn:text>Passport photo in portrait format, 35 x 45 mm, in accordance with the specified passport photo criteria.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_Insurance">
      <bpmn:text>Fully comprehensive travel health insurance for the planned duration of the stay; cover amount EUR 30,000; valid for the entire Schengen area.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_Subsistence">
      <bpmn:text>Sufficient means of subsistence for the duration of the intended stay and for the return journey to the country of origin or residence.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_OtherEvidence">
      <bpmn:text>Other evidence requested by the relevant authorities, e.g. hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, return flight ticket, proof of gainful employment. Evidence may vary by location.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_Check">
      <bpmn:text>Checks the listed requirements and the absence of other grounds for refusal (residence prohibition, alert issued by a Schengen country). Additional documents may be requested depending on the circumstances.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_SubmitSchengen">
      <bpmn:text>Applied at the representation of the country of the main travel destination. If no main destination can be determined, the member country of first entry into the Schengen area is responsible.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_SubmitCategoryAC">
      <bpmn:text>Applied at the representation office in the consular district of the legal place of residence. Exceptional competence may be claimed for third-country nationals legally residing but not registered in the district, with justification.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_SubmitTypeD">
      <bpmn:text>Applied at the competent Austrian representation. Territorial competence is based on place of residence (centre of interest), per Section 8 FPG.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>

rules.instruction: When the description lists documents or conditions that an applicant must provide, and then states that further documents may be requested in some cases, without fixing when or whether they are needed: Model one task that checks the listed documents or conditions before the decision. Then model an exclusive gateway with one labeled branch for requesting the further documents, as its own task, and one labeled branch that continues without them. Join the branches with an exclusive merge before the next step.
rules.situation: the description lists documents or conditions that an applicant must provide, and then states that further documents may be requested in some cases, without fixing when or whether they are needed

rules.instruction: When the description states a decision in which a party or check determines an outcome for an item, and the same sentence names that item and the decision to be made: Label the exclusive gateway as a question about the decision the description states, using the description's own noun for the item being decided (for example, whether the item is approved, successful, or accepted). Do not label the gateway with a classification of the item that the description does not present as the decision point.
rules.situation: the description states a decision in which a party or check determines an outcome for an item, and the same sentence names that item and the decision to be made

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant performs a stated action (for example sending an item, confirming receipt of an item, or assessing an item) and that action is placed in the order before a later decision or step, while another party's response or a later arrival is described only as a result of that action: Model each such stated action as its own user task in the lane of the participant who performs it, at the point the description orders it. Do not replace the action with a start event that represents the arrival of its result, and do not let a gateway that only tests a condition, or a separate task created for a repeated check, stand in for the action itself. Connect the action's outgoing flow to the next element the description ties to it.
rules.situation: the description names one item to organize that bundles several separate negotiations with outside parties (for example, one negotiation for housing and another for a bank account) in a single list entry

rules.instruction: When the description names an activity and attaches to it measurements, dimensions, criteria or qualifying conditions that the item must meet, as a separate clause or parenthetical: Label the task with the bare verb and object that the description gives for that activity, and leave the measurements, dimensions, criteria and conditions out of the label. Keep them in a text annotation attached to that task. Model a separate activity only when the description states a distinct action.
rules.situation: the description names an activity and attaches to it measurements, dimensions, criteria or qualifying conditions that the item must meet, as a separate clause or parenthetical

rules.instruction: When the description states that the office responsible for handling a request depends on the class of the request, with a different assignment rule for each class, and gives no separate step that decides the office: Model the split on the class of the request as one exclusive gateway with a labeled outgoing branch for each class. Connect each branch directly to the task that handles the request under that class's rule. Do not add a separate task before the gateway whose only purpose is to determine which office applies, and do not collapse the classes into one generic handling task. Join the branches with an exclusive merge only where they lead to a common later step.
rules.situation: the description states that the office responsible for handling a request depends on the class of the request, with a different assignment rule for each class, and gives no separate step that decides the office

rules.instruction: When the description states a check of submitted documents or an application against stated requirements, followed by a decision that an authority or other party makes on that submission, and the model needs an exclusive gateway for the outcome of that decision: Label the exclusive gateway with a question that names the deciding party and the object it decides, using the description's own term for the outcome (for example, 'Does the authority approve the request?'). Do not reuse the label of the preceding check, and do not label the gateway with a question about a different decision, such as a category or type choice, that the description states elsewhere.
rules.situation: the description states a check of submitted documents or an application against stated requirements, followed by a decision that an authority or other party makes on that submission, and the model needs an exclusive gateway for the outcome of that decision
